Commercial Water Heaters

We repair, replace and right-size the hot water equipment your business depends on.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

One shared hot water system can feed a kitchen, a row of guest rooms or every restroom in a building. We repair, replace and maintain commercial tank and tankless systems so a single failure doesn't shut you down.

Signs You Need It

  • Hot water running out during busy hours
  • Guests or staff reporting lukewarm water
  • Leaks or rust around the unit
  • Equipment that needs frequent repairs

What To Expect

We assess the system, how much hot water you use and when, and what's causing the problem. Then we repair it or recommend a replacement sized to your demand, scheduled to keep downtime short.

Commercial Services

What We Handle

  • Commercial Tank Units

    Commercial tank water heaters store a large volume of hot water for heavy demand. We repair, replace and size them to match how your business uses water.

    What's included

    • Sizing based on your demand
    • Installation and code-compliant connections
    • Venting and gas or electric hookup
    • Startup and temperature check

    Common signs you need this

    • Running out of hot water at peak times
    • Tank is leaking or rusting
    Get a Quote

  • Commercial Tankless Systems

    Tankless systems heat water on demand and can be linked together for larger loads. They save floor space and deliver a steady supply.

    What's included

    • System design for your demand
    • Installation of single or linked units
    • Gas, venting and water connections
    • Startup and flow testing

    Common signs you need this

    • Need more hot water capacity
    • Limited space for large tanks
    Get a Quote

  • Repair & Replacement

    When hot water fails, we find the cause and repair it when that makes sense. If replacement is the better call, we explain why and keep downtime as short as we can.

    What's included

    • Full diagnostic of the system
    • Parts repair and replacement
    • Recirculation line checks
    • Clear repair or replace recommendation

    Common signs you need this

    • No hot water or lukewarm water
    • Error codes or frequent shutdowns
    • Leaks at the unit or fittings
    Get a Quote

  • Scheduled Maintenance

    Regular service helps commercial water heaters last longer and run efficiently. We flush sediment, check safety parts and catch small problems early.

    What's included

    • Flushing sediment and scale
    • Testing relief valves and safety controls
    • Inspecting venting and connections
    • Service notes for your records

    Common signs you need this

    • No service history on file
    • Rumbling or reduced output
    • Hard water in the area
    Get a Quote
